name: Controlled internal policy and operating procedure

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only lifecycle, approval, implementation, distribution, attachment, and retention controls; author all policy content, facts, roles, and formatting from the new authorized world.

producer: Policy owner with process and control stakeholders
purpose: Define an operational rule, accountable roles, procedures, controls, exceptions, records, and revision governance.
medium: Native Word controlled document with tables and appendices
lifecycle: Drafted, reviewed, approved, published, revised, and retired

authority.governing_scope: Controls the stated internal process for the effective period and covered roles.
authority.non_governing_scope: Examples, superseded versions, and explanatory notes do not override approved requirements.

authorized_inputs: Approved roles, systems, controls, and retention rules
excluded_inputs: Unapproved obligations and fabricated external authority
Prior submission facts and private controls
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The current approved policy controls within scope; external law or executed agreements control where explicitly superior.

natural_depth: Purpose, scope, definitions, roles, and effective date
Stepwise procedure, controls, evidence, exceptions, and escalation
Revision, approval, distribution, training, and retention records
footprint.source_owned_rationale: Length follows the number of governed roles, process steps, controls, exception paths, evidence records, and lifecycle requirements.

sequence: Controlled copy distributed, revised, and retained

prohibited: Examples that silently change the rule

proof_gates.procedure: Verify rule, scope, roles, controls, exceptions, dates, and approvals are complete.
Render and inspect every page, table, appendix, header, and footer.
Inspect properties, revisions, comments, custom XML, links, and embedded content.
Confirm this policy does not own material executable calculations.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: Calculations belong in separately controlled schedules or systems.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace every obligation, role, and control to approved fictional-world governance.
Scan visible and hidden document content for prior-world and evaluation residue.
Distinguish approved requirements, examples, references, and superseded versions.
Map each section and appendix to a governance or operational need.
